title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin surged 11.4 percent overnight to seventy-one thousand seven hundred eleven dollars, driving fresh momentum into the Asia session with Fear and Greed at sixty-two. 

Hashrate remains firm at seven hundred eighty-two exahashes, while the mempool sits at seventy-nine thousand transactions with fees at one sat per vbyte. Block height is nine hundred sixty-three thousand two hundred eighty-seven.
